product_overview: Excalinotion is a collaborative productivity workspace for managing notes, drawings, to-dos, projects, and finances in one frontend app. It also includes help/onboarding and admin tools for site backup and user management.
core_goals: Sign in to the app and access the main workspace
Browse and manage notes, drawings, and to-do content across hierarchical pages
Organize project work in a Kanban board with filtering and markdown card import
Review and manage finance information including accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, and workspaces
Access help content and guided onboarding to learn the product
Use admin tools to manage users and backups when authorized

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with email and password to enter the application, with invite-code-based signup handled separately and not included here.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid email or password -> Submit the form -> See login error message

features.name: Welcome Tour Dismissal
features.description: After first login, users may see a guided welcome tour and can dismiss it to continue into the app.
user_flows: Sign in with valid credentials -> See the welcome tour -> Dismiss the tour -> See the main application

features.name: Workspace Navigation
features.description: Users can open the sidebar and move between major modules of the application.
user_flows: Open the sidebar -> Select a different module -> See the chosen module load in the main area
Open the sidebar -> Switch from dashboard to projects -> See the projects workspace
Open the sidebar -> Switch from dashboard to finance -> See the finance workspace

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: The dashboard provides a home view with favorites, todos, finance snapshot, and notifications.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review favorites, todos, finance snapshot, and notifications -> See the home overview

features.name: Pages and Workspace Content Editing
features.description: Users can create or open pages and work with note, drawing, todo, or split-view content inside the workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to a page in the workspace -> Open a note page -> Edit the note content -> See the changes in the editor
Navigate to a page in the workspace -> Open a drawing page -> Edit the canvas -> See the updated drawing
Navigate to a page in the workspace -> Open a to-do page -> Add or update tasks -> See the task list update
Navigate to a page in the workspace -> Open a split view page -> Work with note and drawing content together -> See both views side by side

features.name: Projects Kanban
features.description: Users manage project cards and columns in a Kanban board, including filtering and importing cards from pasted markdown.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> Open the board -> Review columns and cards -> See the Kanban workspace
Navigate to /projects -> Open card filters -> Search for a card -> Filter by priority -> See the filtered cards
Navigate to /projects -> Open the import cards dialog -> Paste markdown into the text area -> Import the cards -> See the new cards appear in the board

features.name: Finance
features.description: Users review financial data across accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, and workspaces from the finance panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance -> Review the overview data -> See accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, and workspace information
Navigate to /finance -> Open a finance subsection -> Review details -> Return to the finance overview

features.name: Help and Onboarding
features.description: Users can open help content and start a guided tour to learn app features.
user_flows: Navigate to /help -> Review help content -> See product guidance
Navigate to /help -> Start the guided tour -> Follow the tour steps -> See onboarding highlights

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Authorized admins can view user management controls for site administration.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> Review the user list -> Manage user access settings -> See the updated admin state

features.name: Admin Backup Management
features.description: Authorized admins can access backup controls for site administration.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/backup -> Review available backup controls -> Start a backup action -> See the backup management state update

main_modules.name: Dashboard
main_modules.description: Home view with favorites, todos, finance snapshot, notifications

main_modules.name: Pages / Workspace
main_modules.description: Hierarchical pages (note, drawing, todo, split view)

main_modules.name: Projects Kanban
main_modules.description: Boards, columns, cards, filters, markdown import via paste

main_modules.name: Help / Onboarding
main_modules.description: Help content and guided tour modal on first login

main_modules.name: Admin
main_modules.description: Site backup and user management (admin only)

Open sidebar and navigate between modules
